output.summary: An evergreen shrub or small tree native to the South American Andes of Argentina, Bolivia and Peru, tamarillo grows quickly but is relatively short-lived. Its edible fruit is eaten fresh or made into juice, preserves, fruit salad and sauces, although unripe fruit is slightly toxic.
output.edibilityNote: The fruit is eaten fresh or prepared as juice, preserves, fruit salad and sauces; unripe fruit is slightly toxic.
